# BlueBubbles Muse

BlueBubbles Muse gives your Muse agent a real iMessage channel: inbound texts wake the agent through the hook system, and it replies via a BlueBubbles server on your Mac, over Tailscale — nothing touches the public internet. Honest heads-up from the author: experimental and vibe-coded, built on undocumented hooks Meta can change at any time, and insecure by design — sender handles are not authenticated, so the human-configured allowlist is the only inbound gate. Only install if you are comfortable with that.
